parameters.excerpt: A misaligned load or store instruction may be decomposed into a set of component memory operations of any granularity.
parameters.reasoning: The implementation chooses the granularity for decomposing misaligned loads/stores. The spec says 'any granularity', indicating this is an implementation choice.

parameters.excerpt: A floating-point load or store of more than XLEN bits may also be decomposed into a set of component memory operations of any granularity.
parameters.reasoning: Similar to misaligned operations, the implementation chooses how to decompose floating-point operations larger than XLEN bits.
